constraints: Positive reads are required; detected=true with reads=0 cannot create an mNGS candidate.
Missing specimen, molecule, normalization, complete QC, or host metadata is unknown rather than negative evidence.

The missingness route applies only to clinically relevant respiratory, hospital-associated, and opportunistic pathogen families; background, colonizer-prone, and unmapped families are not rescued by missingness alone.
The opportunistic safety net is limited to exact-species high-consequence opportunists with positive mNGS evidence from a compatible specimen.
The missingness and opportunistic safety-net routes can create Context only and can never create High or Picked.
Raw reads, RPM, and ranks remain attached to individual seq_id tests and are never summed across tests.
DNA/RNA concordance and multiple tests from one specimen form one technical reproducibility axis, not independent clinical confirmations.
Route A remains High review only and never Picked.
Species identity, clinical-family routing, and antimicrobial-resistance phenotype are separate claims.
A species-level member of a clinically reviewed complex may use an exact reviewed profile; technical repeats still count as one analytical reproducibility axis.
No patient is forced to have a Picked candidate.
The policy is answer blind; benchmark answers are used only by a separate evaluator.
